scope: Exact installed SDKs only, no latest-web substitution or native claim

styles.name: height
styles.description: Sets both minimal and maximal height to the given value.

styles.name: horizontally_stretchable
styles.description: Whether the GUI element stretches its size horizontally to other elements. `nil` if this element does not support stretching.

styles.name: maximal_height
styles.description: Maximal height ensures, that the widget will never be bigger than than that size. It can't be stretched to be bigger.

styles.name: maximal_width
styles.description: Maximal width ensures, that the widget will never be bigger than than that size. It can't be stretched to be bigger.

styles.name: width
styles.description: Sets both minimal and maximal width to the given value.

element_attributes.name: horizontal_scroll_policy
element_attributes.description: Policy of the horizontal scroll bar.

element_attributes.name: vertical_scroll_policy
element_attributes.description: Policy of the vertical scroll bar.

element_methods.name: clear
element_methods.description: Remove children of this element. Any [LuaGuiElement](runtime:LuaGuiElement) objects referring to the destroyed elements become invalid after this operation.

element_methods.name: destroy
element_methods.description:
Remove this element, along with its children. Any [LuaGuiElement](runtime:LuaGuiElement) objects referring to the destroyed elements become invalid after this operation.

The top-level GUI elements - [LuaGui::top](runtime:LuaGui::top), [LuaGui::left](runtime:LuaGui::left), [LuaGui::center](runtime:LuaGui::center) and [LuaGui::screen](runtime:LuaGui::screen) - can't be destroyed.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: The initial direction of the flow's layout. Defaults to `"horizontal"`.

parameters.name: horizontal_scroll_policy
parameters.description: Policy of the horizontal scroll bar. Defaults to `"auto"`.

parameters.name: vertical_scroll_policy
parameters.description: Policy of the vertical scroll bar. Defaults to `"auto"`.
